gloss: new work, new creation, latest release

definitions.gloss: new work, new creation, latest release
definitions.explanation: A newly created or recently released work, such as a movie, book, clothing item, or other product.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧。
{新作|しんさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}された→発表：03562_happyou⟧。

notes:
{新作|しんさく} refers to a newly created or recently released work. It is used broadly for movies, books, music, games, fashion, food items, and other creative or commercial products.

FORMS:
{新|しん} (new) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work, creation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新作|しんさく}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: new movie
- {新作|しんさく}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧: new novel
- {新作|しんさく}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: new game
- {新作|しんさく}⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧: new menu items
- {新作|しんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce a new work
